shortDescription: Install, remove or query an individual fix or a set of fixes on to IBM i system.

options.name: become_user
options.description: The name of the user profile that the IBM i task will run under. Use this option to set a user with desired privileges to run the task.

options.name: become_user_password
options.description: Use this option to set the password of the user specified in C(become_user).

options.name: delayed_option
options.description: Controls whether the PTF is delayed apply or not

options.name: fix_list
options.description: PTF list that will be applied to the IBM i system.

options.name: fix_omit_list
options.description: The list of PTFs that will be omitted. The key of the dict should be the product ID of the fix that is omitted.

options.name: joblog
options.description: The job log of the job executing the task will be returned even rc is zero if it is set to true.

options.name: operation
options.description: The operation for the fix, the options are as follows load_and_apply will load the PTF and apply the PTF apply_only will only apply the PTF load_only will only load the PTF by LODPTF remove will remove the PTF query will return the specific PTF status

options.name: product_id
options.description: Product identifier to which PTFs are applied.

options.name: save_file_lib
options.description: The library name of the save file to be installed.

options.name: save_file_object
options.description: The object name of the save file to be installed.

options.name: temp_or_perm
options.description: Controls whether the PTF will be permanent applied or temporary applied.
